title: ChameleonEC: Exploiting Tunability of Erasure Coding for Low-Interference Repair
problem: Erasure coding repair traffic in distributed storage systems contends with foreground I/O traffic over shared network bandwidth, slowing repair progress and degrading service quality. Existing repair mechanisms lack dynamic adaptability to varying foreground traffic patterns and unexpected slow nodes (stragglers).
motivation: As storage systems scale and adopt erasure coding for fault tolerance, the high repair bandwidth penalty increasingly threatens both availability (slow repair) and application performance (foreground latency degradation).
method: ChameleonEC decomposes repair plans into fine-grained repair tasks and uses three mechanisms: (1) repair task assignment that saturates unoccupied bandwidth while avoiding contention with foreground traffic; (2) repair path establishment that orchestrates elastic transmission routings across dispatched tasks; (3) straggler-aware re-scheduling that dynamically retunes task transmissions and repair plans to bypass slow nodes. The system is implemented and evaluated on Amazon EC2.
key_novelty: Dynamic decomposition and elastic routing of erasure code repair tasks that co-adapts in real time to foreground traffic occupancy and straggler nodes, without modifying the underlying erasure code.
contributions: Identification that repair traffic and foreground traffic entanglement is the key bottleneck in erasure code repair performance.
Repair task assignment mechanism that saturates idle bandwidth without contending with foreground traffic.
Elastic repair path establishment enabling adaptive multi-path routing across repair tasks.
Straggler-aware re-scheduling that dynamically bypasses slow nodes; 4.9-498.2% repair acceleration on Amazon EC2 across diverse erasure codes and real-world traces.

metrics.speedup: 4.9-498.2% repair acceleration for various erasure codes; 25.4-73.5% speedup in storage-bottlenecked scenarios

baselines: Various erasure codes without ChameleonEC (baseline repair mechanisms)
limitations: Evaluation is conducted on Amazon EC2 cloud instances; performance under different physical network topologies or on-premise deployments is not discussed.
primary_theme: Adaptive erasure code repair scheduling to minimize foreground traffic interference
